statistical_scope: No change to the frozen five-pair by 2,495-locus family, unique-trait Bonferroni gate, or full-family BH correction. A pinned-LAVA 0.1.5 numerical-only patch symmetrizes the block-reduced LD matrix when asymmetry is within 100 * machine epsilon * matrix dimension * matrix scale; larger asymmetry fails. The family, loci, gates, thresholds, and correction remain unchanged.

numerical_stability_patch.target: Only the mathematically symmetric block-reduced LD matrix immediately before recursive eigen decomposition.
numerical_stability_patch.rule: Compute tolerance as 100 * .Machine$double.eps * max(1,nrow(M)) * max(1,max(abs(M))). Symmetrize (M+t(M))/2 only when asymmetry is positive and no larger than tolerance; fail otherwise.
numerical_stability_patch.motivation: Pinned LAVA 0.1.5 uses a general eigensolver on a floating-point block projection; roundoff-level asymmetry can produce tiny complex eigenvalues and abort the cumulative-eigenvalue step.
